P3-DASH-001.detail: Normal Dashboard and the inspected Stat Card/Line Chart configurations expose no current-versus-prior comparison control or comparative result. The Phase 3 comparison workflow cannot be selected.

P3-PROD-001.detail: The live product form/type options contain no serialized inventory mode or per-unit serial-number controls. Basic variants and per-product custom text fields are not unit-identity tracking.

P3-PROD-005.detail: Category management exposes no field/schema definition control. The separate Custom Fields tab configures only an individual product and does not define or inherit category attributes.

P3-TRF-001.detail: No manifest, delivery-slip, PDF/download or print action is exposed at any inspected reachable transfer stage.

P3-TRF-002.detail: The reachable transfer states provide no damage/shortage/discrepancy input, received-quantity adjustment or dispute action; receipt is a whole-transfer completion action.

P3-COUNT-001.detail: The list offers Start a count only. Its form has Branch and Notes; opening a count always freezes the full branch. No category or scheduling control is available.

P3-COUNT-002.detail: Only per-row numeric inputs are present; there is no barcode target/mode, and the emulated SKU plus Enter leaves every counted value unchanged.

P3-EXP-003.detail: Expired rows expose Delete batch only; no disposal/write-off request, supervisor approval or linked disposal ledger is available.

P3-GRN-001.detail: The receiving form exposes accepted/rejected quantities and rejection reason only; no manufacturer lot or expiry capture input is available.

P3-POS-001.detail: Checkout remains on the payment dialog while offline; no sale confirmation/receipt or IndexedDB database is created to retain a durable queued sale. Online mutation processing may remain paused until reconnection.

P3-POS-002.detail: No loyalty/points balance or redemption control is exposed in the POS cart; no loyalty programme appears in the served POS implementation.

P3-QUEUE-001.detail: The editor provides priority, estimated time, ready date and internal notes only. No assignment selector or table/bay input is present.

finding.title: Processing ticket editor cannot assign a technician, service bay or table
steps: Sell an owned processing item through POS.
Open Orders Queue and Edit / Add Note for the resulting owned ticket.
finding.expected: Assign and persist a technician/service bay/table association on the ticket.
finding.actual: The editor provides priority, estimated time, ready date and internal notes only. No assignment selector or table/bay input is present.
finding.comment: The native assignment editor remains absent. Separate explicit API controls accepted and persisted the active current owner, cleared the assignee, and rejected the invalid-ID control without changing the valid assignment. Inactive/cross-business coverage is limited as stated in the summary; no staff account was changed.
finding.environment: Production https://nexstock.stylotech.mu/app; Nexstock QA Company; Windows/Chromium/Playwright 1.62.1; 1920 x 1080; 24 November 2026.
finding.test: F10-a b c owned processing order live states assignment and ticket printing

P3-QUEUE-002.detail: The card menu offers Edit / Add Note and Cancel Order only; there is no ticket/print action.

P3-INV-001.detail: Recurring contract billing cannot be configured. No corresponding workflow is available on the inspected live forms/settings.

P3-INV-002.detail: Invoice editor has no per-invoice currency or recorded exchange rate. No corresponding workflow is available on the inspected live forms/settings.

P3-PO-001.detail: Only manual PO creation and low-stock reporting are available; no automatic reorder policy/schedule or generation workflow is exposed.

P3-PO-002.detail: The inspected PO states expose status changes, print and receive controls but no direct supplier email action or transmission status.

P3-AP-001.detail: The form has an optional PO reference plus aggregate subtotal/tax. It has no goods-receipt/line matching controls; the list has no match status or reconciliation action.

P3-SUP-001.detail: Export downloads supplier profile/contact/credit-term fields. No dated ledger/balance statement or separate statement export action is exposed.

P3-CUST-001.detail: The account form has Individual/Business type and status, but no group/tier selector. Settings > Customers provides custom fields only, with no pricing-tier rules.

P3-REP-001.detail: The report exposes product revenue, cost, profit and gross margin only; there is no net-margin/operating-expense breakdown.

P3-REP-002.detail: Customer receivables aging exists, but no supplier/payables aging report appears in the catalogue or Bills controls.

P3-RPT-001.detail: The form offers a predefined report type, branch and dates only; no dimension/metric or custom query filter editor is present.

P3-DOC-001.detail: The available workflow is preset/form configuration and preview; no editable canvas, element palette or draggable layout elements are exposed.

P3-RBAC-001.detail: No create/add custom role action is present; the Permissions view exposes no editable per-entity matrix.

P3-API-002.detail: Expanded all 39 endpoint accordions in all five Products/Inventory/Invoices/Orders/Customers reference sections. Methods/paths, role/key-scope labels, query/body fields and parseable response examples are present; stale notices are absent. Documented X-Api-Key works without a session or business header, with anonymous/invalid/rotated/revoked controls, read-only deny and write-enabled allow. The validation-error example matches a live 422 control; representative resource reads and both Products/Customers documented pagination envelopes matched live responses. Backend ApiReferenceRoutesTest, OpenAPI diff, every write route and non-owner role gates are not independently certified.

P3-WEB-001.detail: The live catalogue offers invoice.created, credit_note.created, quotation.created, payment.received. Missing required event names: order.created, stock.low, invoice.paid.

P3-HW-001.detail: The live page explicitly states label printing (Zebra ZPL) is not implemented and no label-generation action is exposed.

P3-BACKUP-002.detail: Reclassified from the earlier UI-only finding. The fresh Settings inspection exposes no tenant backup schedule/history, but FEATURES.md F28-f does not mandate tenant-facing controls. No platform schedule/job/artifact evidence is available, so absence or failure of automated backups is unconfirmed. This is not a passed backup capability and is excluded from confirmed bugs; native JSON export is tested separately.

P3-HELP-001.detail: Search/FAQ expansion works, but the catalogue contains no video guide, video player or linked video tutorial.

RET-FONT-001.detail: Fresh tenant TTF uploads were offered and independently selected for both custom fields on Invoice, Quotation, Credit Note editor and POS (two note-boundary runs). No legacy localStorage font list was seeded. Both Invoice/Quotation editors contained one loaded FontFace per uploaded family, and actual Chromium glyphs used the intended Regular/Italic font. Anonymous and invalid-token reads of the owned uploaded font file both returned 401. Credit Note coverage is selector-only; cross-tenant access and physical receipt typography are not certified.

RET-FONT-002.detail: Exact customer text, literal `<b>`/`<tag>` characters, accented É and independent font families survived native Invoice/Quotation create and fresh reads; actual browser glyph fonts and both Modern/Classic native PDF designs passed. Native quotation conversion and both POS sales retained the two definition-backed fields/fonts. Removing a separate owned Italic font retained its text and produced the default PDF fallback. Internal POS note readback is a separate limited control.

limits: Physical printers, label output, scanners and cash drawer checks remain skipped at the user's request; software controls and document generation are distinguished from device operation.

No controlled QA email/SMS inbox or webhook receiver is available. External delivery, signatures/retries and scheduled report delivery are not certified; no external destination or live email schedule is created.
TOTP enrollment, backup-code replay and recovery login remain blocked without an isolated activated account. The shared primary owner's authentication factors are preserved.
Valid own-tenant IDs and nonexistent-ID controls can be tested. Cross-tenant enforcement is not certified without a second authorized disposable tenant.

A missing workflow explicitly required by the feature specification or supplied fix contract is an availability failure. Platform capabilities and unspecified workflow designs cannot be declared broken from UI absence alone; blocked downstream checks remain unverified.
Credit configuration persistence is distinguished from over-limit or expired-credit checkout enforcement. The latter is not certified by the configuration ticket alone.
JSON export job/file behavior is distinguished from full data completeness, database restoration and automated platform backup execution; no production restore is attempted.
This campaign uses Windows/Chromium/Playwright at 1920 x 1080. It is not a fresh full cross-browser, mobile or complete Phase 1/2/3 acceptance campaign.

Backend application source, migrations, OpenAPI changes and ApiReferenceRoutesTest are not bundled in this QA repository. Live functional behavior and expanded production UI documentation are verified; the developer build test is not independently run.

Queue membership controls use the current active QA owner, a nonexistent user and an inactive member only if one is already available. Cross-business rejection is not certified without a second controlled tenant. No member account, role or activation state is altered.
Font tests use licensed Regular/Italic TTF fixtures, invalid TXT and an owned-font removal control. OTF, other font formats and unrelated international writing systems are not certified.

Credit Note coverage verifies font-selector availability/selection only. Saving/printing Credit Note custom text, physical POS receipt typography, queue drag-and-drop and cross-user timing are not certified by these controls.

POS item-note boundaries are checked through native wire values above 255/up to 500 and successful persisted sales. The public Invoice resource does not expose internal item_description, so exact internal-note storage cannot be independently read back. Special Instructions are not assumed to be customer-facing custom fields.
automationCorrections: Calibrated the per-marker PDF oracle with known Regular/Italic embedded TTF fixtures, Unicode text and literal HTML-like characters. JSON output now escapes Unicode to avoid Windows console-code-page corruption; this calibration is not counted as an application pass.

Expanded the prior automation to all four Invoice/Quotation PDF designs, POS and credit-note selectors, POS 256/500-character notes, quotation conversion and removal of an owned temporary font. Native UI selections are not injected or seeded through localStorage.

Corrected PDF table reading order: positional extraction interleaved adjacent Qty/Price cells into wrapped custom text although the literal values were visible. Content-stream extraction was verified against both exact native PDFs; affected native checks passed on rerun.

Removed an incorrect assertion that POS Special Instructions must be returned as a customer custom field. The deployed contract sends internal note separately from definition-backed custom_fields. Long-note checks validate native wire lengths and sale acceptance; exact internal database-note readback is not exposed by the public Invoice resource.

Adjusted the review gate to count the actual loaded FontFace per family. Chromium uses the native FontFace API; requiring a fallback CSS style node was an incorrect analysis assumption, not an application failure.

Corrected case-sensitive API-reference section-label detection: CSS renders QUERY PARAMETERS and REQUEST BODY in uppercase. All five captured sections contain the expected field tables; the native documentation case passed on rerun with case-insensitive matching.
fixtureSummary: Final live audit completed on 24 November at 21:15 Indian/Mauritius: all 89 cumulative ledger-owned catalogue fixtures are archived, none remain active, all owned archived branch balances are zero, and the canonical product matches its captured all-branch baseline. No extra archive repairs were needed.

Owned expiry lots, temporary API keys, saved-report templates and QAP3Font management fixtures are absent. The current campaign stock-count draft is cancelled; stock/transfer recovery ledgers and template restoration checks passed.

Original MVP font IDs 1 and 2 are preserved. Eight diagnostic fonts are deliberately retained: historical 7/8/9/10, superseded current-attempt 11/12 and completed-confirmation 15/16. The separate owned removal-control font 13 and management font 14 were deleted. This preserves reproducibility of retained documents without changing historical fonts.

Current native customer-text evidence: Invoice 312 / INV-QZKMJB, Quotation 42 / QUO-V9FAGW, converted Invoice 313 / INV-EQXG42, POS Invoices 314 / POS-SV8YPUUI and 315 / POS-SNZDSHLF. Earlier attempt documents and removal-control Invoice 311 / INV-TLT4NB remain as traceable QA history. Their owned catalogue products are archived.

Owned inactive customer contacts and synthetic cash sales, credits/debits, purchase orders and adjustment audit history are retained. No external payment or customer email/SMS was requested; no external webhook destination was registered. Raw QA JSON export output is excluded from the portable handoff; no production restore was attempted.
Only automation-owned sessions were revoked/logged out. Existing owner sessions, roles, activation state and authentication factors were preserved.

supplemental.name: Processing-queue assignee membership validation
supplemental.detail: Active current QA owner assignment succeeded and persisted; clear-to-unassigned succeeded. Invalid/nonexistent user control returned 422 without changing the valid assignee. No inactive own-member control was available; inactive-member rejection is not independently certified. Cross-tenant enforcement remains unverified without a second controlled tenant. UI assignment is still absent under P3-QUEUE-001.

supplemental.name: POS item-description length regression
supplemental.detail: Native Special Instructions inputs of 256 and 500 characters produced 363/500-character combined wire notes, both above the old varchar(255) boundary and within the 500-character API limit. Both cash sales returned 201 and their exact Invoices reloaded. Definition-backed customer text/fonts persisted; internal item_description is not exposed for exact readback. No direct database-schema inspection was performed.
